name: Bare Bones x Mods
note: Official Modrinth project identifies a modded Bare Bones resource pack; author lists many supported mods and instructs placing it above its base and overlays. Pack order is author guidance, not a native compatibility result. ARR; no redistribution implied.

name: Farmer GUI
note: Official Modrinth page links the matching CurseForge farmergui project. Warm farmer-themed interface pack. Support lists are split by Minecraft version: do not apply the newer-version list to 1.20.1. ARR; no native verification.

name: Motschen's Better Leaves
note: Official Modrinth page links TeamMidnightDust/BetterLeavesLite. Version 9 uses pre-created leaf textures; customized texture packs may need recompilation. Version 8.1 and earlier dynamically adapt existing textures at a stated performance cost. These are author explanations, not measured FPS here; keep the two behaviors version-scoped.

name: Ars Loafers
note: Official CurseForge project 1254524 by loafobucket is an Ars Nouveau resource pack with addon support. Current description targets 1.21.1, while older files list 1.20.1. Project-wide support is not proof the latest archive works in every lane. Custom license; no native verification.

name: Bibliophilia | Enchanted Books
note: Official project requires CIT Resewn or Forge CIT for 1.18–1.21.1; 1.21.2–1.21.4 is unsupported and 1.21.5 works vanilla. Author reports incompatibility with Dynamic Trims. Do not mark the source native/drop-in claim as dependency-free.

name: Excalibur | Create Support
note: Official Create-to-Excalibur texture/model support pack by BoFill_Pablito. Author places it above Excalibur and publishes distinct Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 archives; exact Create generation matters.

name: Retextures o’ Plenty
note: Official Biomes O Plenty resource pack by IcyCaeli. Author describes changes to over 300 textures and variants, currently for the base mod; addon support is planned rather than implemented.

name: Bare Bones x Farmer’s Delight
note: Official Bare Bones compatibility resource pack for Farmer’s Delight and several Delight addons. Author-listed completion differs by addon; do not promote the whole family to fully supported. ARR.

name: Excalibur | L_Ender’s Cataclysm Support
note: Official project lists Cataclysm entities, items, blocks and spawn eggs, plus random entity variants and 2D inventory icons for weapons. This is visual integration with Excalibur, not new gameplay or native compatibility qualification.

name: Fresh MythicBotany & Botania
note: Official project is a MythicBotany/Botania texture treatment; author explicitly requires Botania and MythicBotany. Retain exact-file version checks and distinguish vanilla-style visual redesign from new magic functionality.

name: L_Ender’s Cataclysm Reimagined
note: Official description limits this pack to GUI, HUD and item icons. It explicitly does not change world models, blocks or gameplay. Separate Forge and NeoForge file lanes are listed; do not mistake this for a complete world-model overhaul.

name: Excalibur | Aether Support
note: Official Aether support pack covers the original Aether visual ecosystem and belongs above Excalibur. Aether addon coverage is planned with no ETA, not completed support. Exact file versions still need qualification.

name: Excalibur | Mowzie's Mobs Support
note: Official Mowzie's Mobs visual support pack by Ruseki lists mobs, bosses, items, particles, boss bars and GUI. Pair with Excalibur and verify the exact mod/file versions. Author permits modpack inclusion but prohibits reuploading or redistributing the pack itself.

name: Excalibur | Iron’s Spells ’N Spellbooks Support
note: Official Iron's Spells Excalibur support pack is explicitly work in progress with many textures missing. Do not mark its catalogue presence as complete visual coverage or functional magic compatibility.

name: Ars Nouveau Refresh
note: Official Ars Nouveau Refresh page documents glyph, essence, charm/familiar and tablet icon redesigns. Mob/weapon/armor styling and addon item improvements appear on its roadmap; do not promote those plans to completed coverage.

name: Chaotix Apotheotic Tweaks
note: Official Apotheosis texture pack targets gems, charms, tomes, rarity materials, arrows and relevant workstations/GUI. It needs Apotheosis to have an effect; its Fabric Zenith version is a separate linked project, not the same compatibility lane.

name: Excalibur | Apotheosis Support
note: Apotheosis block, item and GUI visual support for Excalibur. Author instructs placing this above the base Excalibur pack. Separate 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 v2.0 files are listed; choose the exact target release. This is a visual pack, not an Apotheosis gameplay compatibility patch.

name: Excalibur | Farmer’s Delight Support
note: Author describes 411 item/block textures and considers the pack complete for its stated scope; this is not our runtime qualification of all Farmer’s Delight addons. Place above base Excalibur. Select a release matching the actual Minecraft/mod versions instead of assuming the newest file works on 1.20.1.

name: Pinnacle (for Apotheosis)
note: Apotheosis-only visual refresh; requires Apotheosis to have an effect. Page lists a 1.20.1 3.0.0.5 backport and a separate 1.21.1 3.0.0 release, while the author states ongoing focus is 1.21.1+. Do not treat availability of the backport as a promise of future maintenance. Shares Apotheosis texture targets with other visual packs, so choose precedence and inspect overlaps.

name: Connected Paths
note: Connected-texture resource pack; author requires OptiFine or Continuity. Support is version-scoped: several ecosystems are listed, while Create, Alex’s Caves and others remain planned. A pack-format edit alone does not implement the required connected-texture renderer. The similarly named Connected Paths Mod is a separate dynamic-generation project, not this resource pack.

name: Stay True
note: Vanilla-style visual variation pack. Author lists OptiFine for connected textures, overlays and pink birch leaves, and advises fancy leaves plus appropriate connected-texture/alternate-block settings. The page has pack-priority advice for Fabric users; renderer alternatives and a specific Forge/Vulkan stack need separate validation. Distinct from Stay True Compats Reforged.

name: Ars Naturae
note: Nature-themed Ars Nouveau visual pack using brown woods, mossy stone and blue Source styling. Author mentions addons without a complete support inventory. The inspected project lists a 1.20.1 file; do not infer 1.21.1 support or coverage of every Ars addon. Compare overlapping texture targets with other Ars visual packs.

name: Excalibur | Supplementaries Support
note: Unofficial Supplementaries visual compatibility pack. Author still lists presents and flags as missing despite broad block/decor/icon coverage. Separate release lanes exist; match the exact game/mod version. Visual support does not establish gameplay compatibility or permission to reuse its artwork.

name: Excalibur | Clarent Edition
note: Unofficial Excalibur backport/fix patch. Its page names Excalibur 1.21.10 as the supported base, while the separately inspected Fresh Animations Patch page recommends 1.21.11 for older Minecraft targets. This guidance differs: pin the intended pack versions and test the actual stack rather than combining the recommendations blindly.

name: Excalibur | Fresh Animations Patch
note: Requires the matching Fresh Animations and Excalibur resources plus ETF/EMF or OptiFine; author warns about current OptiFine issues and lists Epic Fight, Accelerated Rendering, Better Animation Collection and animal/hostile Fresh Animations addons as incompatible. Clarent and base-pack version instructions vary by Minecraft target. These are author-reported constraints, not a newly tested renderer matrix.

name: Excalibur | Hearth and Harvest Delight Support
note: Hearth and Harvest visual support aligned with Excalibur Farmer’s Delight, including 3D crops and extra detail on some functional blocks. The page lists distinct Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 files. This does not add the underlying farming gameplay or prove coverage of unrelated Delight addons.

name: Excalibur | My Nether's Delight Support
note: Visual support for My Nether's Delight, which is distinct from the older Nether's Delight mod. Separate 1.20.1 v2.1 and 1.21.1 v2.2 files are listed. Intended to match Excalibur and TC_'s Farmer's Delight treatment; exact stack and gameplay compatibility remain untested.

name: BnC Coaster Compat
note: The atlas's opaque project ID u0btsBB7 redirects to BnC Coaster Compat. Its page lists Minecraft 1.20–1.20.1 and additional Brewin' and Chewin' coaster models for selected foods from Farmer's Delight, Neapolitan, Create and other named mods. Some existing item models/textures are overwritten. Distinct from Modded Coasters and More Coaster Compat; review overlapping assets and current mod-provided models before stacking.

name: Brewin' And Chewin' | Excalibur Support
note: Excalibur-style blocks, items, interface and coaster-model textures for Brewin' And Chewin'. Author claims at least 97% of textures edited, which is not an independently audited completeness result. Page recommends TC_'s Farmer's Delight resource pack and lists 1.20–1.20.1 and 1.21–1.21.1. Check asset precedence with other coaster packs.

name: Pixel Perfection x Farmer's Delight
note: Farmer's Delight textures for the Pixel Perfection Legacy/Fidelity style, with Corn Delight and beta Rustic Delight support stated. Page prose says standalone use is possible, while its dependency list marks a Pixel Perfection base pack required; retain this discrepancy and test the intended stack. Broad listed Minecraft versions do not establish every exact release/mod combination.

name: The Rename Compat Project
note: Language/display-name resource pack that distinguishes similarly named mod content and normalizes naming. It does not merge registries, replace blocks, deduplicate recipes or prove gameplay compatibility. Author describes en_US language files and lists some projects as supported but not included; do not treat the broad support list as shipped exact-version coverage.

name: Create BDCraft
note: BDCraft-style Create patch. Author lists Minecraft 1.20/1.21 and separate Create 5/6 coverage at 32x, 64x, 128x, 256x and 512x. Select the matching Create/game file and intended resolution; higher texture resolution is not automatically a performance improvement or a native compatibility certificate.

name: Faithful 32x Modded
note: Classic pre-1.14 Programmer Art-style mod textures for older Minecraft versions, with vanilla textures included. The current main file is a 1.12.2 release, not a ready-made 1.20.1 pack. The author describes 300+ supported mods and some coming-soon entries; distinguish available files and textures from planned support before any port.

name: Fresh Mowzie's Mobs textures
note: Texture refresh for Minecraft 1.20–1.20.1: the page lists Frostmaw, Foliaath and baby, both Grottol variants, Naga, Ferrous Wroughtnaut and Lantern. More coverage is planned. The name does not establish Fresh Animations integration, new animations, complete mob coverage or gameplay compatibility.

name: Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks Reimagined
note: Visual weapon/staff models and selected GUI icons, including some animated inventory previews. The author says OptiFine is not required. Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 have separate files; choose the matching game/loader release. Appearance changes do not establish new spell mechanics, balance changes or complete coverage of future items.

name: SPBR-Farmer’s Delight
note: Adds LabPBR normals, parallax, reflections, emission and subsurface scattering to Farmer’s Delight. The linked SPBR guidance requires a shader supporting LabPBR and parallax, with those features enabled. Optional effects depend on shader settings. Shader cost, exact renderer support and Hari/Vulkan compatibility remain untested; the atlas’s historical drop-in label is not proof.

name: Bare Bones x The Aether
note: Minecraft 1.20.1 Bare Bones-style Aether textures. The author lists The Aether, Lost Content, Enhanced Extinguishing, Treasure Reforging and Protect Your Moa. Aether Redux and Deep Aether are explicitly planned rather than currently included; do not promote them to shipped coverage.

name: Better Leaves - Hexerei
note: Bushier Hexerei mahogany, willow and witch hazel leaves for 1.20/1.20.1. The author says Motschen’s Better Leaves is not required, although the packs can be used together. Vanilla leaves are unchanged; this is selected decorative coverage, not a general foliage or gameplay compatibility patch.

name: Biomes You’ll Go 3D Flora
note: Selected 3D vine and mushroom models for the Biomes You’ll Go family. The listing offers 1.19.2 and 1.20.1 files, says no backports before 1.19.2, and ties later ports to the author’s own pack migration. Do not infer complete flora coverage or interchangeable BYG/BWG registries from the informal title; inspect the exact file before installation.

name: Crops 3D Reforged
note: Vanilla-style 3D crop/plant models combine cubes and planes with vanilla-derived textures. The described coverage includes crops, stems, fungi, berries, saplings, flowers and potted variants. Several game-version files exist; the displayed latest main file can be an older game lane, so choose the target version rather than blindly taking the main download. No measured FPS claim.

name: Crops 3D Reploughed
note: Separates NinthWorld’s crop assets into Crops, Flowers and Saplings packs for selective resource-pack stacking, with game-version metadata and a nether-wart texture-filename fix. The author points users seeking all three parts together toward Reforged. This is a distinct packaging option, not a duplicate identity or proof that both should be layered over the same assets.

name: Excalibur | Quark Delight Support
note: Excalibur-style retextures for the Quark Delight add-on, with listed 1.20–1.20.1 and 1.21–1.21.1 lanes. The author links separate Farmer’s Delight and Quark support packs; this patch does not imply it includes either base mod’s complete retexture or gameplay compatibility.

name: Whimscape x Oh The Biomes We’ve Gone
note: Whimscape-style BWG patch with 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 listings. The author says wood and ground types are retextured and All The Wood We’ve Got is included, while most extra plants remain untouched. Broad biome coverage is not complete flora coverage; confirm the exact mod and file versions.

name: 3D Crops Revamped
note: NinthWorld-derived crop/plant model refresh, distinct from Reforged and Reploughed. The author describes clearer growth stages, reduced repetition, colored stems and floating-texture fixes, with a separate Barebones version linked. Lightweight and shader-supported are author descriptions, not measured performance or exact renderer qualification.

name: BareBones x BetterEnd
note: Bare Bones-style BetterEnd retextures. Listings include 1.19.x, 1.20–1.20.4 and 1.21–1.21.1. The title’s broad coverage statement is an author claim; exact asset completeness against a particular BetterEnd release has not been audited. This is a visual resource pack, not a loader port or gameplay compatibility patch.

name: Mekanism BDCraft
note: BDCraft-style Mekanism texture patch with 1.20/1.21 file lanes and 32x, 64x, 128x, 256x and 512x resolutions. The author recommends the separate PureBDCraft base-game pack. Pick the matching mod/game version and resolution; higher resolution is not automatically better performance, and whole-mod coverage remains an author claim until asset auditing.

name: The Aether BDCraft
note: BDCraft-style Aether texture patch for the listed 1.20 lane, with 32x through 512x options. The author recommends the separate PureBDCraft base-game pack. Exact Aether build coverage and texture-memory cost remain untested; do not infer 1.21 support from other BDCraft patches.

name: Xali’s Bushy Leaves - Regions Unexplored Addon
note: Minecraft 1.20.1 Regions Unexplored foliage add-on for Xali’s Bushy Leaves. The page also describes optional ambient-occlusion restoration and extended BetterNether/BetterEnd coverage, and supplies an illustrated pack order. These optional expansions and ordering requirements are separate from the core pack; no blanket Complementary/Hari/Vulkan compatibility is established.

name: Applied Energistics 2 BDCraft
note: BDCraft-style AE2 texture patch with 1.20/1.21 lanes and 32x, 64x, 128x, 256x and 512x variants. The author recommends PureBDCraft for the base game. This is an appearance patch rather than storage-network logic or gameplay integration; exact build coverage and performance require tests.

name: Better Leaves for Bare Bones x Fruit’s Delight
note: Fruit’s Delight is required; Bare Bones, Bare Bones x Farmer’s Delight and the related Better Leaves pack are strongly recommended. The 1.20–1.20.1 listing describes leaf, flower and fruit-block textures for thirteen fruit types. Cherry leaves are not included. Keep requirements distinct from style recommendations and do not claim complete tree coverage.

name: Biomes o’ Plenty 3D Flora
note: Selected 3D models for Glowshroom, Glowworm Silk, Toadstool and Willow Vines. The author lists 1.18.2, 1.19.2 and 1.20.1 files and declines earlier backports. This is four named flora targets rather than a complete Biomes o’ Plenty model overhaul.

name: Cataclysm: Spellbooks Reimagined
note: Targets GUI, HUD and item icons for Cataclysm: Spellbooks, with seven described icon redesigns and separate Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 releases. The author explicitly excludes world models, blocks and gameplay and says OptiFine is not required. Its simplified-model wording must not be promoted to a full in-world Cataclysm overhaul or measured performance gain.

name: Croptopia Blocky Crops
note: Minecraft 1.20.1 Croptopia crop models. The listing describes broad crop coverage but the exact installed-version asset set has not been audited. The author credits Crops 3D Reforged inspiration and Farmer’s Delight rice textures; these references do not establish functional cross-mod integration or blanket asset reuse rights.

name: Just Oh The Biomes We’ve Gone
note: Vanilla-like BWG retexture for the listed 1.20–1.20.1 lane, illustrated with Skywood, Rainbow Wood and stone examples. Treat it as a distinct visual option from Whimscape and other BWG patches; screenshots alone do not prove complete block coverage or safe stacking of overlapping textures.

name: Mizuno’s x Farmer’s Delight
note: Mizuno-style Farmer’s Delight retexture. The author uses Refabricated and describes Forge support as possible rather than verified; do not promote this to tested Forge compatibility. Match the exact pack file to the installed release.

name: Quark BDCraft
note: PureBDCraft-style Quark patch for the 1.20 line, offered at 32x, 64x, 128x, 256x and 512x. Resolution selection changes texture-memory demand; the page does not establish a measured performance result or blanket reuse rights.

name: (Brewin’ and Chewin’) 3D delight foods & drinks
note: Adds 3D food/drink presentation on Brewin’ and Chewin’ coasters and explicitly requires the Forge mod. The listed 1.20.1 release covers Farmer’s Delight, Farmer’s Respite, Youkai’s Homecoming, End’s Delight and Galospheric Delight; additional planned addons are not completed coverage.

name: Dandelion X
note: A 16x continuation of Steelfeathers’ Dandelion with vanilla-friendly textures, animations and models plus optional enhanced features. Author guidance names EMF/ETF, Continuity and Polytone for portions of its enhanced support. Newer vanilla CIT support is version-specific, not a 1.20.1 guarantee; match release and feature dependencies.
